clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he found out who was "the smart one" in a federal prison business office over a pen.

Everyone just grabbed a pen and filled out the form, no questions asked. Kevin picked up a green one, and a supervisor stopped him: "you have to use black ink."

He asked why. The supervisor couldn't answer. The form was going into a filing cabinet nobody had opened in years.

Most people just follow the rule. Intelligent people ask why the rule exists in the first place.

When's the last time you actually asked why, instead of just complying?

Kevin Trudeau says the smartest move he ever made at a fancy dinner was admitting he had no idea what he was ordering.

He was at a nice restaurant with a table of wealthy people, and sweetbreads were on the menu. He had no clue what that actually meant.

Instead of nodding along, he just asked the waiter straight up: what exactly are sweetbreads?

Turns out it's organ meat. The table laughed - but Kevin says it didn't make him look stupid. It made him look confident.

When was the last time you asked the question everyone else was too embarrassed to ask?

#kevintrudeau #confidence #mindset #success #motivation #selfimprovement

Kevin Trudeau says a legendary marketer gave him one of the best compliments of his life, almost by accident.

He was at dinner with Jay Abraham, one of the most respected marketing minds alive, who talked for a full 18 minutes explaining one concept.

Kevin listened the whole time, then summed up everything Jay said in a single sentence. The table went quiet - then Jay told him he had "the ungodly ability" to take something complicated and simplify it.

Kevin says Einstein did the same thing on purpose, rewriting an idea again and again until a thousand pages became a hundred.

Can you explain what you do in one sentence?
